model_rule: Call MOOR.request. Never bypass the sealed Funnel Kernel for build/change work. Harness requires a valid moor.funnel-receipt.

fallback.rule: No key is required. Reuse known references/local rules, mark fallback provenance, and continue.

manufacturing.principle: Pulse Beam is the HMI/digital twin; contracts, state transitions, evidence and receipts are authoritative.
manufacturing.work_order_rule: Build/change requests enter MOOR.request as persistent software work orders; known machinery becomes BOM material; Funnel receipt authorizes the route; Harness receives and returns the same work_order_id; verified Harness output closes Harness + verifier travelers into a ReleaseRecord, while failed output remains explicit nonconforming WIP.

twin_contract.rule: Renderers consume the snapshot; they do not infer or create authority/health.

cumulative_machinery.law: Verified reusable capabilities accumulate. Reuse or compose them before creating substitutes.
cumulative_machinery.deprecation_rule: Deprecated machines leave preferred routing but remain addressable for replay, rollback and dependent assemblies.
cumulative_machinery.discovery_rule: Resolve compatible verified machinery and known compositions before novel implementation.
cumulative_machinery.removal_rule: No silent deletion or shadow replacement of verified machinery.

blueprint_farm.execution_rule: Blueprints are planning artifacts. Only an explicitly released slice with valid Funnel execution authority may enter build execution.
